meta.name: SeatHeater
meta.description: Seat heating function. Supports switching on and off and adjusting seat temperature. When enabled, the temperature of the seat Space gradually rises toward the target; the device cannot actively cool. When disabled, the temperature gradually approaches cabin temperature.

power.description: Whether seat heating is powered on.

target_temperature.description: Requested heating target for the containing seat Space.

cabin_temperature_reference.description: Deterministic passive equilibrium reference representing cabin temperature. While the heater is off, the containing seat Space approaches this temperature.

get_target_temperature.description: Return the requested heating target for the seat. Requires the seat heater to be powered on.

target_temperature.description: Requested heating target in degrees Celsius.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The seat heater must be powered on.

set_target_temperature.description: Set the heating target to an integer from 16 through 35 degrees Celsius. Requires the seat heater to be powered on. Invalid input or a failed power precondition leaves state unchanged.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The seat heater must be powered on.
errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Target temperature must be an integer from 16 through 35 degrees Celsius.

get_cabin_temperature_reference.description: Return the deterministic cabin-temperature reference used for passive seat-temperature equalization. Requires the seat heater to be powered on.

cabin_temperature_reference.description: Passive equilibrium reference in degrees Celsius.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The seat heater must be powered on.

set_cabin_temperature_reference.description: Set the deterministic cabin-temperature reference used after power-off to an integer from -50 through 80 degrees Celsius. This setting must represent the cabin temperature for the simulated scenario. Requires the seat heater to be powered on. Invalid input or a failed power precondition leaves state unchanged.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The seat heater must be powered on.
errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Cabin temperature reference must be an integer from -50 through 80 degrees Celsius.

set_power.description: Set power and dependent property access. While off, every non-power property is inaccessible through public getters/setters. Turning on restores access. A property marked auto_reset resets only when turning on.

tick.description: While powered on and the containing seat Space seat_temperature is below target_temperature, approach target_temperature by at most 1 degree Celsius per minute; emit no effect when the seat is at or above the target, so the heater never actively cools. While powered off, approach cabin_temperature_reference from either direction by at most 1 degree Celsius per minute. Emit no effect when the applicable target has already been reached.

effect_properties.name: power
effect_properties.description: Determines whether the seat is actively heated or passively approaches equilibrium.

effect_properties.name: target_temperature
effect_properties.description: Determines the active heating target while power is on.

effect_properties.name: cabin_temperature_reference
effect_properties.description: Determines the passive equilibrium target while power is off.
